evidence_sources.title: Safari 14 JavaScript support for optional chaining
evidence_sources.relevance: WebKit identifies Safari 14 as introducing optional chaining; the owner iPad requirement includes iOS 12, so the Owner PWA avoids syntax unavailable to that engine.

evidence_sources.title: Safari 13.1 JavaScript support for nullish coalescing and String.replaceAll
evidence_sources.relevance: WebKit identifies Safari 13.1 as introducing these features; equivalent ES2018-compatible null checks and global underscore replacement preserve behavior for older iOS.
